name: NeILF Rendering and Loss Calculation
definition: A rendering pipeline that decomposes Gaussian Splatting features into diffuse, specular, and ambient components using a Blinn-Phong model, supporting inverse rendering via loss functions on depth, normals, and color sparsity.
summary: NeILF Rendering and Loss Calculation is a differentiable pipeline that decomposes Gaussian Splatting into diffuse, specular, and ambient components using Blinn-Phong shading to enable inverse rendering and material editing.
